author: BloodSport
body:
Username: BloodSport
Why banned: Death Threats
Why I should be unbanned: Well considering I have a 9 year old brother who likes to get on my laptop without permission,I came into my room and he was playing on a different server, he then told me he was on the second server on my server list (avicus) and got banned because he told some guy to kill himself. He has previously gotten me in trouble before on the server.

If unbanned, I will be sure to put a password that logs into my account whenever I shut the lid so he can't get on. I also promise if unbanned, this situation, or anything of the sort would never come out of my account for I am nearly 16 years old and I know how to act around other people and I would be the only one in control. I wasn't expecting this to happen and I have been putting off having a lock on my computer for long time.

I hope you can understand my situation here, and I understand this being one of the most cliche excuses in the book, but I could swear to you that It would never happen again. I have played on the server for over a year and have been in hundreds of matches on the server and gathered tons of the cosmetic credits trying to buy one of the name modifications. If you want to ban my brothers account which shares the same ip as mine, considering we live in the same house, his accounts name is "Dibly". You can find it on https://namemc.com/s?Dibly which is a website where you can check usernames.

I hope you can consider my appeal

Best regards, Bloodsport

title: Banned

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Bloodsport,

Your account is your responsibility, it's not our fault your brother had access to your account. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
